function_summary: Brushed planetary gearmotor with quadrature encoder for powered mechanisms.
classification_reason: Drive torque makes it a locomotion actuator; optional arm use needs an engineered transmission and feedback control.
assembly_notes: One gearmotor with encoder; wheel, motor driver, power and structure are separate.
evidence_note: Specs identify brushed DC, planetary reduction, output shaft and magnetic quadrature encoder.

function_summary: N20 brushed gearmotor with metal spur reduction.
classification_reason: Suggested as a compact wheel-drive component; an arm joint is an alternative mechanism, not supplied.
assembly_notes: One gearmotor; wheels, mounts, driver and controller are additional.
evidence_note: Specs identify brushed DC operation, D-shaft, metal gearing and 210:1 ratio.

function_summary: Standard positional servo with steel gears and H25T output spline.
classification_reason: Angular positioning suits a joint or gripper drive; head or leg use is an alternative only after load and mounting checks.
assembly_notes: One torque-ratio servo; arm links, gripper structure and control electronics are separate.
evidence_note: Manufacturer goBILDA product description and specs confirm torque variant, PWM travel and position feedback after initial ServoCity fetch failed.

function_summary: Standard hobby servo providing controlled angular movement with nylon gears.
classification_reason: Suggested joint actuator for an arm; can move a light head or leg mechanism but is not an assembled limb.
assembly_notes: One servo; structural links, mount, power and signal source are separate.
evidence_note: Product description lists nylon gearing, H25T spline and servo rotation.

function_summary: Controls speed and direction of one brushed DC motor using a PWM input.
classification_reason: Motor-control electronics support motion without supplying a mechanical limb.
assembly_notes: Single-channel controller with included mounting hardware; motor, battery and signal source are separate.
evidence_note: Wiring instructions identify separate motor, battery and receiver connections and a built-in BEC.

function_summary: Dual brushed-motor controller supporting encoder feedback and multiple control interfaces.
classification_reason: Electronics drive actuators; the board is not an arm or leg assembly.
assembly_notes: Controller only; motors, encoders where needed, power and host control are separate.
evidence_note: Description confirms two brushed DC channels and closed-loop encoder control.

function_summary: ATmega32U4 programmable board in an Arduino-style form factor.
classification_reason: Internal computation and GPIO belong to support; mounting in a torso does not make it a structural torso.
assembly_notes: Board with female headers and no microSD support in this configuration; actuators and sensors separate.
evidence_note: Product description explicitly identifies the MCU, Arduino form factor and configuration without microSD.

function_summary: Laser time-of-flight ranging module with analog distance or digital threshold output.
classification_reason: Perception suggests a head sensor; it does not include a mechanical head.
assembly_notes: Sensor, listed mounting hardware and adapter cable; host controller and head mount separate.
evidence_note: Description explains reflected-laser timing and analog/digital modes; included hardware and wiring are listed.

function_summary: Mecanum locomotion chassis kit with four planetary gearmotors and four 104 mm wheels.
classification_reason: A powered drive base supplies the movement role represented by legs in the builder.
assembly_notes: Assembly required; BOM includes chassis structure, drivetrain, wheels, wiring and tools, not a battery or motor controller.
evidence_note: Product description and BOM list four motors, mecanum wheels and channel-frame parts.

function_summary: Omni wheel with lateral rollers for holonomic robot drivetrains.
classification_reason: Ground-contact wheel is a locomotion component, not an articulated leg.
assembly_notes: One 96 mm omni wheel; hub, drive motor, chassis and electronics are separate.
evidence_note: Description explains lateral rolling and a 14 mm center hole with mounting patterns.

function_summary: Set of 96 mm mecanum wheels for omnidirectional ground movement.
classification_reason: Wheel set is part of locomotion; it does not include a complete powered base.
assembly_notes: Wheel set; motors, chassis, hubs and controller must be supplied separately.
evidence_note: Product identifies a mecanum wheel set and describes coordinated operation of four wheels.

function_summary: Rechargeable 12 V NiMH battery pack with XT30 connection.
classification_reason: Energy storage supports every body role; it is not a structural torso.
assembly_notes: Battery pack; charger and battery mount are listed separately.
evidence_note: Specs confirm NiMH chemistry and capacity; description explains placement inside channel structure.
